questions.question: How can a company reduce its Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) using AWS?

options.text: By having no responsibility for third-party license costs.

questions.explanation: AWS shifts capital expenditure (CapEx — building data centers upfront) to operational expenditure (OpEx — pay-as-you-go), removing large initial ownership costs.

questions.question: Which options does AWS make available for customers who want to learn about security in the cloud in an instructor-led setting? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Classroom Training (live virtual or in-person courses) and Online Tech Talks (live educational webinars with interactive Q&A) are AWS's instructor-led education options.

questions.question: Which of the following will enhance the security of access to the AWS Management Console’? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Access to the AWS Management Console is front-facing web traffic. Enforcing Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and strict password policies directly protects these logins.

questions.question: Which of the following features can be configured through the Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) Dashboard? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Subnets and Security Groups are core networking constructs managed directly within the Amazon VPC interface.

questions.question: For which auditing process does AWS have sole responsibility?
questions.explanation: Under the Shared Responsibility Model, AWS is solely responsible for the physical security of data centers, infrastructure hardware, and the virtualization layer.

questions.question: Which of the following are advantages of AWS consolidated billing? (Select TWO)

options.text: The ability to receive one bill for multiple accounts.
Service limits increasing by default in all accounts.
A fixed discount on the monthly bill.
Potential volume discounts, as usage in all accounts is combined.
The automatic extension of the master account’s AWS support plan to all accounts.

questions.explanation: Consolidated billing groups multiple sub-accounts onto one invoice and treats aggregate usage as a single total, qualifying you faster for volume-tiered pricing discounts.

questions.question: Which of the following common IT tasks can AWS cover to free up company IT resources? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: With managed services (like Amazon RDS), AWS handles routine tasks such as patching the underlying OS/database engine and managing automatic backups.

questions.question: A company wants to expand from one AWS Region into a second AWS Region. What does the company need to do to start supporting the new Region?

options.text: Contact an AWS Account Manager to sign a new contract.
Move an Availability Zone to the new Region.
Begin deploying resources in the second Region.
Download the AWS Management Console for the new Region.

questions.explanation: AWS Regions are independent. To expand into a new Region you simply point your tools/scripts there and start deploying — no new contract is required.

questions.question: Why is it beneficial to use Elastic Load Balancers with applications?

options.text: They allow for the conversion from Application Load Balancers to Classic Load Balancers.
They are capable of handling constant changes in network traffic patterns.
They are provided at no charge to users.

questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancers automatically distribute incoming traffic across multiple targets and are designed to handle constantly changing network traffic patterns.

questions.question: Which is the MINIMUM AWS Support plan that allows for one-hour target response time for support cases?
questions.explanation: The Business Support Plan is the lowest tier offering 24/7 technical support by phone and chat, plus a target response time of under 1 hour for production system impairments.

questions.question: What is the lowest-cost, durable storage option for retaining database backups for immediate retrieval?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 provides highly durable storage with millisecond retrieval. Glacier classes require longer retrieval, so standard S3 is the right answer for immediate online access.

questions.question: What AWS team assists customers with accelerating cloud adoption through paid engagements in any of several specialty practice areas?
questions.explanation: AWS Professional Services is a global team of experts offering paid engagements that help enterprises accelerate their cloud migration journey.

questions.question: A company needs 24/7 phone email and chat access with a response time of less than 1 hour if a production system has a service interruption Which AWS Support plan meets these requirements at the LOWEST cost?
questions.explanation: The Business Support Plan is the minimum tier with 24/7 phone/chat support and a sub-1-hour response target for production issues.

questions.question: If a customer needs to audit the change management of AWS resources, which of the following AWS services should the customer use?
questions.explanation: AWS Config continuously monitors and records your resource configurations, letting you audit configuration history and evaluate changes for compliance.

questions.question: How does AWS Trusted Advisor provide guidance to users of the AWS Cloud? (Select TWO)

options.text: It identifies software vulnerabilities in applications running on AWS.
It provides a list of cost optimization recommendations based on current AWS usage.
It detects potential security vulnerabilities caused by permissions settings on account resources.
It automatically corrects potential security issues caused by permissions settings on account resources.
It provides proactive alerting whenever an Amazon EC2 instance has been compromised.

questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor checks your configurations against best-practice pillars and returns actionable findings, including under-utilized resources (cost) and loose permissions (security).

questions.question: Which AWS managed service is used to host databases?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS is the managed service for hosting relational SQL engines like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.

questions.question: Which of the following Identity and Access Management (IAM) entities is associated with an access key ID and secret access key when using AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI)?
questions.explanation: Programmatic calls via the AWS CLI require an Access Key ID and a Secret Access Key tied to an IAM user.

questions.question: Under the shared responsibility model, which of the following is the customer responsible for?

options.text: Ensuring that disk drives are wiped after use.
Ensuring that firmware is updated on hardware devices.
Ensuring that data is encrypted at rest.
Ensuring that network cables are category six or higher.

questions.explanation: Data protection, configuring encryption (at rest and in transit), and managing access keys are the customer's responsibility under the shared model.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides a simple and scalable shared file storage solution for use with Linux-based AWS and on-premises servers?
questions.explanation: Amazon EFS provides a simple, serverless, elastic NFS file share optimized for Linux workloads.

questions.question: What credential components are required to gain programmatic access to an AWS account? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Interactive sign-ins use a username/password; programmatic actions (SDKs, CLI) use the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key pair.

questions.question: Which of the following is a shared control between the customer and AWS?

options.text: Providing a key for Amazon S3 client-side encryption.
Configuration of an Amazon EC2 instance.
Environmental controls of physical AWS data centers.

questions.explanation: Shared controls are handled by both parties. Awareness & Training fits: AWS trains its staff, and you must train your own employees on security.

questions.question: Which type of AWS storage is ephemeral and is deleted when an instance is stopped Of terminated?
questions.explanation: Instance Store volumes live on disks physically attached to the host and are ephemeral — data is lost if the instance stops, hibernates, or terminates.

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of consolidated billing on AWS?
questions.explanation: Consolidated billing combines usage across accounts onto one invoice, helping you reach volume discount tiers faster.

questions.question: Which services are parts of the AWS serverless platform?

options.text: Amazon EC2, Amazon S3, Amazon Athena.
Amazon Kinesis, Amazon SQS, Amazon EMR.
AWS Step Functions, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon SNS.
Amazon Athena, Amazon Cognito, Amazon EC2.

questions.explanation: Step Functions (orchestration), DynamoDB (NoSQL), and SNS (pub/sub) are all serverless — no servers to provision or scale.

questions.question: Which of the following Amazon EC2 pricing models allow customers to use existing server-bound software licenses?
questions.explanation: Dedicated Hosts allocate isolated physical servers entirely to you — meeting compliance needs for physical isolation and enabling bring-your-own-license (per-socket/per-core).

questions.question: Which of the following security measures protect access to an AWS account? (Select TWO)

options.text: Grant least privilege access to IAM users.
Create one IAM user and share with many developers and users.
Activate multi-factor authentication (MFA) for privileged users.

questions.explanation: Granting least-privilege permissions gives users only the access they need, and MFA protects privileged admin accounts from compromise.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides the ability to manage infrastructure as code?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudFormation lets you model, provision, and manage your entire environment using declarative code templates (YAML/JSON).

questions.question: What is an advantage of deploying an application across multiple Availability Zones?

options.text: There is a lower risk of service failure if a natural disaster causes a service disruption in a given AWS Region.
The application will have higher availability because it can withstand a service disruption in one Availability Zone.
There will be better coverage as Availability Zones are geographical^ distant and can serve a wider area.
There will be decreased application latency that will improve the user experience.

questions.explanation: Availability Zones are isolated locations within a Region. Deploying across multiple AZs ensures high availability — if one AZ fails, the others handle traffic.

questions.question: A customer needs to run a MySQL database that easily scales. Which AWS service should they use?
questions.explanation: Amazon Aurora is a fully managed MySQL/PostgreSQL-compatible database built for the cloud that scales storage automatically (up to 128 TB).

questions.question: Which of the following is an AWS Cloud architecture design principle?
questions.explanation: Loose coupling is a core design principle: components are independent, so one failing doesn't cascade across the whole system.

questions.question: AWS Enterprise Support users have access to which service or feature that is not available to users with other AWS Support plans?
questions.explanation: The Concierge Support team is exclusive to the Enterprise Support plan — it provides billing and account assistance. Trusted Advisor and support cases are available on other plans too, so they aren't Enterprise-only.

questions.question: A company will be moving from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. What would be one financial difference after the move?

options.text: Moving from variable operational expense ( opex ) to upfront capital expense (capex).
Moving from upfront capital expense (capex) to variable capital expense (capex).
Moving from upfront capital expense (capex) to variable operational expense ( opex ).
Elimination of upfront capital expense (capex) and elimination of variable operational expense ( opex ).

questions.explanation: Moving to the cloud shifts spending from upfront capital expense (CapEx — buying and owning hardware/data centers) to variable operational expense (OpEx — pay-as-you-go for what you use).

questions.question: When performing a cost analysis that supports physical isolation of a customer workload, which compute hosting model should be accounted for in the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)?
questions.explanation: Dedicated Hosts give you isolated physical servers, satisfying compliance isolation requirements and supporting bring-your-own-license.

questions.question: Which AWS service should be used for long-term, low-cost storage of data backups?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 Glacier storage classes are designed for low-cost archival of backups that don't need millisecond access.

questions.question: Which is the MINIMUM AWS Support plan that provides technical support through phone calls?
questions.explanation: The Business Support Plan is the minimum tier with 24/7 phone/chat support and a sub-1-hour response target for production issues.

questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 instance pricing model can provide discounts of up to 90%?
questions.explanation: Spot Instances use spare EC2 capacity at up to 90% off, but they can be interrupted with a 2-minute warning.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS services can be used to serve large amounts of online video content with the lowest possible latency? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 stores large raw video assets, while Amazon CloudFront caches and delivers that content from edge locations worldwide for low-latency streaming.

questions.question: What can AWS edge locations be used for? (Select TWO)

options.text: Reducing traffic on the server by caching responses.
Sending notification messages to end users.

questions.explanation: Edge locations (via Amazon CloudFront) bring content closer to users and cache static data, reducing load on your origin servers.

questions.question: A company is planning to migrate from on-premises to the AWS Cloud. When AWS tool or service provides detailed reports on estimated cost savings after migration?

options.text: AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Calculator.

questions.explanation: The AWS TCO Calculator (now part of the AWS Pricing Calculator / Migration Evaluator) models on-premises vs cloud costs side by side to estimate savings before migrating.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides a customized view of the health of specific AWS services that power a customer’s workloads running on AWS?
questions.explanation: The AWS Personal Health Dashboard (now part of the AWS Health Dashboard) alerts you about events affecting your specific resources, unlike the broad Service Health view.

questions.question: One of the advantages to moving infrastructure from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud is:

options.text: It allows the business to eliminate IT bills.
It allows the business to put a server in each customer’s data center.
It allows the business to focus on business activities.
It allows the business to leave servers unpatched.

questions.explanation: By offloading physical infrastructure management to AWS, a business stops spending on running data centers and can focus on its core activities.

questions.question: How can an AWS user with an AWS Basic Support plan obtain technical assistance from AWS?
questions.explanation: AWS Basic Support (free) includes only documentation, whitepapers, and the AWS Discussion Forums / re:Post community. Technical Account Managers and direct engineer support require paid plans (Business/Enterprise).

questions.question: How can a user protect against AWS service disruptions if a natural disaster affects an entire geographic area?

options.text: Deploy applications across multiple Availability Zones within an AWS Region.
Use a hybrid cloud computing deployment model within the geographic area.
Deploy applications across multiple AWS Regions.
Store application artifacts using AWS Artifact and replicate them across multiple AWS Regions.

questions.explanation: If a disaster impacts an entire Region, deploying your application across multiple AWS Regions is the way to achieve geographic disaster recovery.

questions.question: Which activity is a customer responsibility in the AWS Cloud according to the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.text: Ensuring network connectivity from AWS to the internet.
Patching and fixing flaws within the AWS Cloud infrastructure.
Ensuring the physical security of cloud data centers.
Ensuring Amazon EBS volumes are backed up.

questions.explanation: AWS secures the underlying storage hardware, but configuring and scheduling backups of your volumes (e.g., EBS snapshots) is your responsibility.

questions.question: In which scenario should Amazon EC2 Spot Instances be used?

options.text: A company wants to move its main website to AWS from an on-premises web server.
A company has a number of application services whose Service Level Agreement (SLA) requires 99.999% uptime.
A company’s heavily used legacy database is currently running on-premises.
A company has a number of infrequent, interruptible jobs that are currently using On-Demand Instances.

questions.explanation: Because Spot Instances are interruptible, they are ideal for non-production, flexible background and batch-processing jobs.

questions.question: A customer is deploying a new application and needs to choose an AWS Region. Which of the following factors could influence the customer’s decision? (Select TWO)

options.text: The application’s presentation in the local language.
Proximity to the customer’s office for on-site visits.

questions.explanation: Latency (proximity to users) and compliance (data sovereignty laws requiring data to stay in specific countries) are primary factors when choosing a Region.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides alerts when an AWS event may impact a company’s AWS resources?
questions.explanation: The AWS Personal Health Dashboard gives personalized alerts about events impacting your specific resources, unlike the broad Service Health Dashboard.

questions.question: Which disaster recovery scenario offers the lowest probability of down time?
questions.explanation: Multi-site active-active runs traffic across multiple fully functional sites at once, giving near-zero RTO/RPO compared to warm standby or pilot light.

questions.question: Which service’s PRIMARY purpose is software version control?
questions.explanation: AWS CodeCommit is a fully managed, secure source-control service that hosts private Git repositories.

questions.question: How can a customer increase security to AWS account logons? (Select TWO)

options.text: Use Amazon Cognito to manage access

questions.explanation: As in Q3, enforcing MFA and strong password policies are the fundamental ways to secure interactive identity logins.
